text:
Do not keep the chairman waiting. Head to the
seafood restaurant—the Captain’s Table.\c
So you will not forget the chairman’s face,
I will give you one of his League Cards.[VAR 0114(0007)]

Chairman Rose is the kind of man who gets
downhearted if he doesn’t take care of things he
needs to right away...\c
Go to the seafood restaurant as soon as
possible, so as not to keep the chairman waiting.[VAR 0114(0007)]
